description: This file defines the BidiFirefox class, a specialized BrowserType for Firefox in the Playwright project, including methods for environment setup, connection, and handling browser startup issues.

classes.name: BidiFirefox
classes.description: A class extending BrowserType, implementing Firefox-specific browser control and environment setup for Playwright.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no specific executable path is set.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the browser via transport and options.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to provide clearer error messages related to Firefox launch issues.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for launching Firefox, ensuring correct home directory and crash reporter settings.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a close message via transport to gracefully close the browser.

methods.name: supportsPipeTransport
methods.description: Indicates whether pipe transport is supported (returns false).

methods.name: prepareUserDataDir
methods.description: Prepares the user data directory with Firefox preferences.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Firefox, including profile and headless options.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready by listening for WebDriver BiDi connection message.
